Led by the Quezon City Government, this November 18 summit unites LGUs, experts, and partners from all sectors to confront flooding challenges and craft shared, lasting solutions for a resilient future.

Be part of the movement — join us in building a safer, more resilient Metro for all.

When: November 18, 2025
Time: 8:00 AM - 5:00 PM
